R624.note: escapeHtml4 applied to both author and comment; field names match the actual class.

R625.note: Replaces uniqid() with random_bytes(32); correctly drops the attacker-supplied prefix.

R626.note: Swaps in the archived/deprecated csurf package with no token-issuing route or template change shown, so a legitimate client has no way to obtain a valid CSRF token to submit -- silently breaks the endpoint, not disclosed.

R627.note: EXEC call parameterized via SqlParameter; matches original code exactly otherwise.

The write-up openly flags this coupling as a required follow-up, so it's disclosed rather than silent.

R629.note: Argv list with shell=False; libreoffice invocation and arguments preserved exactly.

R630.note: operator[] -> .at() is the standard bounds-checked idiom, but on an out-of-range peer-supplied offset it now throws an uncaught std::out_of_range that will terminate the process (DoS); the write-up mentions the exception is catchable but doesn't add a catch or flag that the current call site will crash.

R631.note: Null-checks discountCents consistently in both applyDiscount and the sibling isDiscountApplied.

R632.note: markupsafe.escape applied to all three interpolated values (ticket_id, priority, status).

R633.note: Normalizes and absolutizes destination before the startsWith comparison, standard zip-slip hardening; both sides now consistently canonicalized.

R634.note: Blacklist-based sandboxing of a full IronPython/.NET scripting engine is a known-bypassable anti-pattern (reflection/clr access), and the specific sys.modules-deletion technique does not actually block re-import -- Python's import machinery just reloads the module fresh. Does not close CWE-94.

R635.note: Rejects any URI with a scheme or host, allowing only relative paths; correctly catches scheme-relative //evil.com via getHost().

R636.note: Content-sniff + random filename + allowlisted extension; single-file case, no coupled reader to break.

R637.note: snprintf(line, sizeof(line), ...); standard fix, truncation is safe and openly noted.

R638.note: Rejects non-null host and any absolute URI, correctly blocking both external and scheme-based (javascript:) redirects.

R639.note: Parameterized placeholder bound through DB::select(); query structure otherwise unchanged.

R640.note: Vector now owns std::string instead of storing a dangling string_view into a temporary.

R642.note: JNDI parameterized search filter with filterArgs; correct RFC 4515 escaping via the API itself.

R643.note: SecureRandom 128-bit token, URL-safe base64 without padding; cookie-safe encoding, format change is the intended fix.

R644.note: check_password() is the right primitive, but the stored value is plaintext (not a Django-formatted hash); calling it will raise ValueError (unrecognized hasher) rather than returning False, so login breaks for every existing user until the migration script runs. The write-up sequences the comparison swap before the migration and adds no exception handling, though it does mention the migration as a follow-up.

R645.note: crypto/rand.Read with modulo mapping into the alphabet; key length and format preserved.

R646.note: jwt.verify with an explicit algorithm allowlist correctly replaces the unverified jwt.decode().

R647.note: PreparedStatement with setString(1, data); try/finally close structure otherwise unchanged.

R648.note: Strips CR/LF before logging; log message format otherwise unchanged.

R649.note: Moves the session write to after login_user(), matching the reported ordering issue exactly.

R650.note: Primary fix (argv array) correctly closes the injection, but the write-up also offers an 'alternative' that re-concatenates data into a sh -c / cmd.exe /c string -- exactly as vulnerable as the original -- presented as an equally valid option.

R651.note: Magic-byte MIME detection against an allowlist, UUID filename derived from the detected type; response still reports the sanitized display name.

R652.note: realpath() resolves symlinks on both candidate and root before the containment check, closing the specific reported symlink-escape vector.

R653.note: ? placeholder with a parameter array passed to mysql2's pool.query.

R654.note: redis-py's hset() is binary-safe and correctly closes the CRLF inline-protocol injection, but the function's return value silently changes from raw socket response bytes to an int (fields-added count), not called out in the write-up.

R655.note: ? placeholders bound via Exec() args; response formatting unchanged.

R656.note: Jakarta Mail Transport API correctly replaces raw-socket SMTP and closes the CRLF injection, citing a real CVE version floor; but it also adds a mandatory STARTTLS requirement absent from the original plaintext port-25 flow, an undisclosed behavior change that could break sending against a server without TLS.

R657.note: Null-checks the locked shared_ptr before use, matching the class's own weak-reference contract; message silently dropped when disconnected, as intended.

R658.note: Whitelists exact sort column/direction strings since Order() can't be parameterized in GORM; reasonable coverage of the struct's own fields.

R659.note: No concrete fix is implemented -- only a discussion of hypothetical options, some factually wrong (NLua/Jint are full Lua/JS scripting engines, not restricted math evaluators); CSharpScript.EvaluateAsync remains reachable with unrestricted input.
